newsitem.title: USA: Former Orange County, Calif., CEO to head Lottery.
newsitem.headline: Former Orange County, Calif., CEO to head Lottery.

text.p: William Popejoy, who led Orange County, Calif.,'s bankruptcy recovery team in 1995, was named Tuesday as director of the state Lottery, Gov. Pete Wilson said on Tuesday.
Popejoy, 59, was Orange County's chief executive officer for several months in 1995. In that post, he helped implement a debt recovery plan for the county.
He has been the chairman of Pac Pro, a custom packaging manufacturer in Santa Fe Springs, Calif., since 1991. He was chairman and chief executive officer of American Savings Bank from 1984 to 1989.
He will receive a salary of nearly $108,000 per year. The appointment is subject to Senate confirmation.
